title: Lovable Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Lovable produces the most polished AI app builder output, but it falls short on default security, credit pricing, and CRM depth. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Lovable's three biggest gaps natively, security on by default instead of a documented 2026 exposure incident, flat pricing instead of credit burn plus separate Cloud usage billing, and native lead/CRM routing instead of no path at all, and it's a more complete platform overall: native mobile apps, a customer-facing AI gateway, and built-in growth tooling are all things Lovable doesn't offer at any tier. More options are listed in our[Lovable alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/lovable-alternatives) roundup.
